description: This Java interface defines the contract for CSRF (Cross-Site Request Forgery) defense strategies within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for generating tokens, limiting subfolder URLs for token lookup, modifying CSRF tokens in requests, determining token reuse policies, and handling invalid tokens.

classes.name: ICsrfDefenseStrategy
classes.description: An interface that specifies methods for CSRF protection strategies in the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: maxSubFolderInRequestUrlForTokenMapLookup
methods.description: Determines the maximum number of subfolders in the request URI to limit the number of CSRF tokens needed.

methods.name: modifySecurityCsrfToken
methods.description: Overrides the CSRF token value in the request map for a given URI and method.

methods.name: keepTokenAfterUse
methods.description: Indicates whether to reuse a CSRF token after it has been used.

methods.name: invalidTokenResponse
methods.description: Handles the response when an invalid CSRF token is detected.
